QuestInfo.name: Making Horny Mushroom Pie
QuestInfo.1:
Camila asked you to get ingredients for a Horny Mushroom Pie.

Eliminate Horny Mushrooms in #m100020200# and get ingredients for the pie.
QuestInfo.2: Camila started making some yummy Horny Mushroom Pie for the townspeople. Might need a better name, though...
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 683
Can proceed to Pie Presentation
Can proceed to Gift for the Chief

0.0: I'm going to make something very special for the townspeople of Henesys! Will you help me again? Please?

yes.0:
I'm going to make a Horny Mushroom Pie this time! There's a lot of ingredients this time... #b5 Horny Mushroom Caps, 3 sacks of Flour, 3 jars of Honey, 1 Red Horny Mushroom Cap#k.
I'll get the kitchen ready so if you could get those ingredients, I'd appreciate it.

Eliminate the Horny Mushrooms in #r#m100020100# and #m100020200##k to get them.

no.0: I promise! This is the last time! Help me, okay? Please, please, please!!

1.0: Whoa, that was fast! Let me see... Wow, you brought everything! That's amazing. I bet it's all gonna make an amazing pie, too! I'll get to work right now.\r\n

yes.0: Smells pretty good, right? I bet everyone is going to love it. Utah loves Horny Mushroom Pies too. Why, just saying the name makes folks laugh with joy!

item.0: I'll need 5 Horny Mushroom Caps, 3 sacks of Flour, 3 jars of Honey, 1 Red Horny Mushroom Cap to make a Horny Mushroom Pie. You can get these ingredients from hunting Horny Mushrooms, naturally.\r\n
